The report lists these failures:
1. Six-month persistence of V05 rises (share of recent months up) gave negative IC and high rank autocorrelation.
2. Standardizing V03 against its expanding history gave essentially zero IC and weak coverage.
3. Coverage of the best feature is only 63%.
4. Lagging weakens the signal.

The proposed expression is spread(tsz(V04,60), tsz(V03,60)). It uses V03 standardized against its own history, which is the V03 standardization that produced zero IC and weak coverage. The window is 60 months rather than expanding, but it is essentially the same approach. The hypothesis references "prior V03-minus-V04 spread had negative IC", which is not in this report, so it is not clearly grounded. It does not explicitly avoid the V03 failure, and it uses V03 standardization directly as a component. It does not address coverage or the persistence failure either.

So it does not explicitly avoid the failure; it arguably repeats one.

{"avoids_failure": false}
